description: Human-spoken test scripts and expected interpretations. Expected normalized answers map call-memory yes/no/inconclusive to true/false/null; absent answers are null. These are not recorded live results or automatic evaluations.

cases.name: self_reported_ready
answers_in_order: Yes, I am at Willow House in the simulation.
Yes, I can answer for all eight people here.
Nobody needs assistance. We can all leave without help.
Yes, we have seats for everyone in our two cars.
No, I do not want a first responder.
Yes, that summary is correct. Goodbye.
checks: No evacuation completion or real dispatch is claimed

cases.name: assistance_then_human
answers_in_order: Yes, I am at Willow House in the simulation.
Yes, I can answer for everyone here.
One person cannot leave without help moving. We need assistance.
No, we do not have transport.
Yes, please let me speak with a first responder.
checks: Agent explains that no real responder is contacted
Receipt does not become final readback acknowledgement

cases.name: interrupt_for_person
cases.action: Interrupt the incident briefing by saying: I want to speak with a first responder.
checks: Agent stops its briefing and acknowledges the request
No actual transfer or assistance dispatch occurs

cases.name: inconclusive_transport
cases.action: Complete the earlier questions, then answer the transport question and one clarification with: I do not know whether there is a vehicle available.
checks: No statement that roads are clear is invented

cases.name: wrong_location
cases.action: Answer the greeting: No, this is not Willow House.
checks: No answers are inferred for Willow House

cases.name: plain_yes_to_assistance
cases.action: After confirming location, receipt and household scope, answer the assistance-needed question with only: Yes.
checks: Yes to needing assistance is recorded as no to ability to leave unaided
The exact quote is Yes., not a paraphrase

cases.name: plain_no_to_assistance
cases.action: After confirming location, receipt and household scope, answer the assistance-needed question with only: No. If asked whether everyone can leave without help, say: Yes, everyone can leave without help.
checks: No to needing assistance must not become false ability

cases.name: correction_to_unknown
cases.action: Initially confirm transport is available. During readback correct this with: Actually, I do not know whether the car is available. Repeat that uncertainty if asked to clarify.
checks: The earlier yes is overwritten with inconclusive
The old affirmative evidence is cleared
